dek: Each issue takes one claim about latency, queues or storage, tests it on real hardware and shows the numbers. Here is this week’s, as it lands.

issue.subject: Your p99 is lying: coordinated omission, measured
issue.preheader: One load test, run two ways. At p99.9 the number moved from 41 ms to 1.1 s.
issue.title: Your p99 is lying
body: Most load generators wait for a reply before sending the next request. When the server stalls, the generator stalls with it, and the requests that should have queued are never sent.
So the histogram looks healthy, because the worst moments were never sampled. We re-ran one test with a fixed send schedule:

figure.title: Latency by percentile, log scale
figure.alt: Latency by percentile on a log scale. Waiting for each reply reports 41 ms at p99.9; a fixed send schedule shows 1.1 s at p99.9 and 1.9 s at p99.99.
